# I3-2 匹配损害预算的收益—风险实验

所有主要控制器共享冻结候选mixer；强度由selection在0.5%、1%、2%和5%预算内选择。

## 预注册判定

| criterion | datasets_passed | required | pass |
|---|---|---|---|
| contribution-probability family reaches Pareto front | 4 | 3 | True |
| contribution family beats simple controls at matched 2% test harm | 3 | 3 | True |
| selection-gamma test harm remains within 2% budget | 4 | 3 | True |
| selection-gamma correction rate exceeds negative flips | 4 | 4 | True |
| selection-gamma has no >0.5pp mean accuracy loss | 4 | 4 | True |
